note: The versions this project is supposed to cover, and the eras they belong to. tools/targets.py prints a verdict for each one: real Java (a JVM in the page), one layer away, or blocked by the runtime. Scope: through 1.21.11. 26.x and later are out of scope until an engine for that client generation exists.

groups.name: Latest snapshot
groups.why: so a new version is never a surprise

groups.name: Legacy but modern enough
groups.why: modded servers, old worlds, the versions mods were written for

groups.name: Pre-release eras
groups.why: Indev, Alpha and Beta: tiny clients, everything they need is inside the jar

groups.name: The 1.21 line
groups.why: the newest generation this project supports: compiled from the official client, vanilla, with the mods path documented rather than pretended

groups.name: Out of scope (v1 stops at 1.21.11)
groups.why: 26.x is a different client generation (Java 25 and a rewritten renderer), so it is not supported yet: it needs an engine for that generation, and the plan says so instead of offering a build that cannot happen
